title: Structure of POU2AF1 recombinant protein and it affects the progression and treatment of liver cancer based on WGCNA and molecular docking analysis.
authors: Li, Xin; Zhou, Hongxu; Ma, Ruiyang; Guo, Wei; Yang, Xu; Li, Xiang; Liu, Zhe; Zhong, Yifan; Jing, Zuoqian
one_liner_zh: 该文利用WGCNA和分子对接研究POU2AF1重组蛋白在肝癌中的结构特征及与相关蛋白的互作，虽涉及蛋白-DNA相关蛋白和分子对接，但核心是肿瘤表达与药物敏感性分析，非TF-DNA结合机制研究，方法深度有限。
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma, also referred to as HCC, is the most frequent form of primary liver cancer. It is anticipated that the discovery of the molecular pathways related with HCC would open up new possibilities for the treatment of HCC.WGCNA (Weighted gene co-expression network analysis) and molecular docking analysis were used to study the structural characteristics of POU2AF1 recombinant protein and its interaction with related proteins. Normal samples were placed in one group, and tumor samples were placed in another group inside the GEO database. We continued our investigation of the DEGs by performing an enrichment analysis using GO and KEGG. The GSCA platform is utilized in the process of doing an analysis of the connection between gene expression and medication sensitivity. In the end, the core target and the active molecule were both given the green light for a molecular docking investigation. POU2AF1 is being considered as a possible therapeutic target for HCC, and the results of our work have presented novel concepts for the treatment of HCC.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是原发性肝癌中最常见的形式。预计与HCC相关的分子通路的发现将为HCC的治疗开辟新的可能性。本研究采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和分子对接分析来研究POU2AF1重组蛋白的结构特征及其与相关蛋白的相互作用。在GEO数据库中，正常样本分为一组，肿瘤样本分为另一组。我们通过使用GO和KEGG进行富集分析，继续研究差异表达基因（DEGs）。GSCA平台用于分析基因表达与药物敏感性之间的关联。最后，核心靶点和活性分子均被批准进行分子对接研究。POU2AF1被认为是HCC的潜在治疗靶点，我们的研究结果为HCC的治疗提出了新概念。
